main_text.l: tu[?]atum esse, nec hoc diffitetur præstan-
tissimus Dallæus; De solâ formâ lis est,ne-
gat enim idem Dallæus ubi suprà eandem
nem, quam præ se fert Valentini hæresis,
niam si hæc forma vetustiorum jam fuerat,
nisi hoc fœliciter exsequatur, actum erit
de Epistolico suo Ignatio, cujus fronti ad
num se posteriorem ferire, neque ejus h-
annis natam pulsare potuit; tamen si Lo-
gi ex Sige emissio, proprius fuit Valenti-
nianæ hæresis character, negari non po-
test quin ad eam respexerit Autor Epistolæ
non talem esse qualem vult Dal-
[?] The first word of the page is read as "tuatum"; it is probably "tantum" with a worn n, but the scan does not show it clearly.

page.notes: The first word "tuatum" is doubtful (the letters n and a are unclear). The paragraph ends with "Dal-" at the line end; it continues on the next page. No other doubtful readings. Show-through and the scan's edge are not transcribed.
